talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 46 solo PCPs winding down in Louisiana; 7 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Monroe 71201, Lafayette 70503, New Iberia 70560) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~6,980 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.

**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Assumption Parish, St. Bernard Parish, St. Mary Parish) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 19 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~104,400 patients across 87 at-risk practices statewide.
